protocol_metadata.about: Solv Protocol is an on-chain capital allocator and Bitcoin operating layer that tokenizes BTC into three unified assets: SolvBTC (1:1 Bitcoin receipt), xSolvBTC (yield-bearing BTC with instant redemption), and BTC+ (a strategy allocation hub directing capital into risk-adjusted yield strategies). Users deposit BTC to mint these tokens, which can then be deployed across DeFi lending, liquidity pools, and institutional yield strategies. Contracts are upgradeable via OpenZeppelin's framework, with a unified Gnosis Safe multi-sig as cross-chain upgrade administrator, and use Safe-based Vault Guardian (Solv Guard) to constrain asset managers to pre-approved on-chain actions.
